description: Defines an abstract class Vtiger_PDF_Viewer for rendering PDF views in the vtiger CRM system, including methods for setting models and abstract methods for display management.

classes.name: Vtiger_PDF_Viewer
classes.description: An abstract class for viewing PDF documents, providing a structure for setting label models and requiring subclasses to implement display-related methods.

methods.name: setLabelModel
methods.description: Sets the label model object used in the PDF viewer.

methods.name: totalHeight
methods.description: Abstract method to calculate total height of the PDF view, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: initDisplay
methods.description: Abstract method to initialize display settings, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Abstract method to perform the display of the PDF content, to be implemented by subclasses.
